_: The files the app loads, by the names the code uses (adrift-core/src/assets.rs FILES), and where each is in this repository. Terra's own data is borrowed as it is (tools/ocean/build.py, tools/globe/build.py and ground.py built it); files under adrift/data/ are Adrift's own. tools/adrift/assets.py assembles a directory of them for a shell. `sheets` says how each sheet is decoded (Truth's builders write their own entries) and the credit each is owed.

eddy.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html
eddy.source: NOAA GDP current variance (Laurindo, Mariano and Lumpkin 2017) times the Lagrangian integral time scale measured from GDP 6-hourly trajectories 2016-2023
eddy.step: a Gaussian step of standard deviation sqrt(2 K dt) metres on each axis
eddy.what: lateral eddy diffusivity, zonal in R and meridional in G, how measured in B

eddy-time.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html
eddy-time.source: measured from GDP 6-hourly trajectories 2016-2023 in 10-degree boxes, smoothed
eddy-time.what: the Lagrangian integral time scale, zonal in R and meridional in G

wind.credit: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA
wind.source: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1, long-term monthly means 1991-2020 (NOAA PSL)
wind.what: the month's mean 10 m wind, eastward in R and northward in G

currents.what: the month's mean near-surface current, eastward in R, northward in G, how measured in B (Terra's OceanCurrents.png, tools/ocean/build.py)
currents.source: NOAA GDP drifter climatology v3.10 monthly means (Laurindo, Mariano and Lumpkin 2017), CC BY 4.0
currents.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html

stream.what: the month's stream function, sixteen bits (R high, G low): (R * 256 + G) / 65535 * 0.4 - 0.2, m/s radians on the unit sphere (Terra's OceanStream.png)
stream.source: solved from the currents by tools/ocean/build.py
stream.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html

ice.what: month MM's usual sea-ice concentration, grey, 255 all ice; a float is held at 0.15 and over (Terra's Globe/ground/ice-MM.png, tools/globe/ground.py)
ice.source: NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4, monthly means 2015-2024
ice.credit: Fetterer, F., K. Knowles, W. N. Meier, M. Savoie and A. K. Windnagel. Sea Ice Index, Version 4. NSIDC

coast.what: signed distance to the coast, fine in R (128 + 8 d, |d| <= 16 px) and coarse in G (128 + d / 2), land positive, in pixels of 360/4096 degrees (Terra's Globe/geo.png, tools/globe/build.py)

drifters.what: real GDP drifter runs at a point a day (tools/adrift/data/drifters.py has the layout)
drifters.source: NOAA GDP 6-hourly interpolated trajectories (Lumpkin and Centurioni, doi:10.25921/7ntx-z961), CC BY 4.0
drifters.credit: This study used data collected and made freely available by the NOAA Global Drifter Program (https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/phod/gdp/) accessed from https://erddap.aoml.noaa.gov/gdp/erddap/index.html
